description: The owner's team (2026-11-16; the Corrosion setup set found by efsim rules --guided, 2026-11-22). While the enemy hasn't Corrosion at level 4: at 4 Heat stacks Arcane's battle skill (her Nature on 4 stacks forms a full-strength Corrosion), else Akekuri's battle skill from 200 SP outside her ultimate (her Heat builds the stacks). Then ultimates when ready, combos when lit, Estella's battle skill after Arcane's combo, Si's battle skill only when her button shows it (Artful Intent isn't up; no Initial Stroke), spare SP (200) to Akekuri's battle skill outside her ultimate. Against the list without the set, on 64 fresh seeds (1001–1064, 300 s, 0.3 s reaction) and the objective across starts (the mean of full energy and from zero per seed): +1.06% ± 0.33 (full energy +1.31% ± 0.53, 53,243 → 53,941; from zero +0.82% ± 0.41, 52,745 → 53,176); as found, without the guard on Akekuri's ultimate (the rules check: it ended her ultimate), +1.71% ± 0.30. Arcane's press alone (without Akekuri's setup press): +0.94% ± 0.27; moving the spare-SP rule to the top alone: −0.07% ± 0.06. Level-4 Corrosion is up 0–33% of a fight (about 33 s each, 0–3 a fight): 4 Heat stacks are rare beside Si's and Estella's Cryo.
